posts.title: Coronagraph Watch
posts.text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 11, 2026

NASA’s DONKI logged a new coronal mass ejection, making the outer corona worth a look.

☀ CME start: September 09, 2026 at 16:09 UTC
💨 CME speed: 228 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: S-type (<500 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 44° (Moderate)

We're watching the corona today!

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-1
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

posts.title: Morning Sunwatch
posts.text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — September 11, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.3 (Peaked September 11, 2026 at 01:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 405 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)

Several sunspot groups and broad coronal-hole regions are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clearly unusual outward structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
